error_404_text: The crew looked everywhere and couldn't find it. It may have moved, or the link is off.

import_empty: There's no code in that archive.
import_failed: The import didn't work. Try again.

phase_retrying_now: Couldn't reach the model provider. Retrying now (attempt {attempt}/{max})

support_articles_empty: No articles yet. Write the first one, or publish a draft.

support_delete_confirm: Delete "{title}"? Nomi stops answering from it.
support_drafts_empty: No open questions. Everything asked so far was in the knowledge base.

support_key_once: Copy this key now: it won't be shown again.
support_lede: Nomi answers your customers from the knowledge base, and hands you what it couldn't answer.

perm_maintenance_desc: Turning maintenance mode on and off

integ_lede: Services Nomi works with, and everything you can do with them.

integ_duplicate: New environment from an existing one
integ_secrets_hint: Values go straight to Shipyard. Nomi doesn't keep them and no agent ever sees them.
integ_secret_name_rule: Use A–Z, 0–9 and _, like an environment variable.
integ_secret_saved: Secret saved. Services using it pick it up on their next deploy.
integ_terminate_hint: Removes the app everywhere: every environment, its data, the dev database and secrets.
integ_terminate_confirm: {name} is removed from Shipyard with all its data. The Nomi project stays.
integ_delete_secret_confirm: {name} is removed; services using it lose it on their next deploy.
theme_lautan: Deep sea blue with a lagoon-green glint.
theme_matcha: Soft matcha green with roasted tea.
theme_saffron: Warm saffron gold against a violet dusk.
theme_lagoon: Clear cyan water over coral sand.
theme_graphite: Quiet greys with a touch of brass.
appearance_all_themes_lede: Each one recolours Nomi and the admin console, in light and dark.
chatpage_personality_hint: Ask Nomi to change it. Say “in all chats” to make it your default.
maintenance_until_hint: Leave empty if you don't know yet: people see “We'll be back soon”.
integ_webhook_missing: Nomi's webhook isn't set up on Shipyard

integ_webhook_needs_app_url: Set APP_URL on the server to Nomi's public address first, so Shipyard knows where to send events.
integ_webhook_switched_off: Nomi's webhook is switched off on Shipyard, so no events arrive. Turn it on in the Webhooks tab.
feature_showcase: Live apps people built with Nomi
showcase_lede: Live apps people built by chatting with Nomi's crew. Open one and try it.
showcase_empty_hint: Publish an app with Nomi and turn on Show in the showcase in its settings.
showcase_cta_line: Got an idea? Koda can build it.
showcase_setting_hint: Anyone can see the app, its name and this line on Nomi's public showcase.
showcase_setting_unpublished: Publish the app first: only live apps can be shown.
billing_cached: {tokens} from cache · counts as a tenth
integ_add_url_hint: A public https address that reads the raw body and replies 2xx within 10 seconds.

integ_add_no_types: Shipyard didn't list its event types.
domain_unpublished: Publish the app first: its first publish gives it an address.
domain_hint: Where people open the app. Changing it frees the old name for anyone to take.
domain_dns_hint: Shipyard creates the DNS record and the HTTPS certificate for the address, on publish and when it changes. There's nothing to set up.
domain_custom_soon: Using a domain you own (like shop.example.com) isn't available yet: Shipyard doesn't support it so far.
domain_change_lede: Pick a name for the app. Names are shared by every app on the platform, so one that's in use can't be taken.
pj_transfer_owner_told: The owners of {org} get a notification and an email saying the project is theirs now.
pj_transfer_shipyard: The published app moves to {org} on Shipyard too, with its data and settings. Its address stays the same; it restarts once.
prefs_home_hint: Pick the page you land on. You can switch any time.
home_layout_classic_hint: Composer and crew side by side, then your day and recent chats.
home_layout_stage_hint: A frosted stage with the crew drifting behind a centred composer.
home_layout_today_hint: Your day up front, then the composer and recent chats beside the crew.
prefs_backdrop_hint: The softly moving crew behind your chats and the Stage home. Turn it off for a plain, still background.
